title: huge and thin
text: huge and thin. These run large on my typical beds. I don't know why I keep buying them.  I have a set for a twin bed, a full sized bed, and a queen sized bed. After washing and drying there is still a lot of room left. The fitted portion does not fit snug to the bed. I even have additional mattress padding on the bed and these still run large. I do not have thin mattresses- nothing special.  Without the additional padding they can almost fit around the box spring too. These might be perfect for those who have the newer super deep mattress options and are looking for extra deep fitted sheets. The flat sheet is fine- doesn't matter how big that is.  As for material- they are soft and feel nice. They are super light weight. These are not crisp sheets- they are simply soft. I do like that the company has interesting colors to select from. I am still using the sheets on all the beds I mentioned, I just wish they fit snuggly. Because they fit so loosely, the material begins to bunch up when tossing and turning. Something to keep in mind.
